name: io.github.enthouan/simplelogin-mcp
title: simplelogin-mcp
description: Independent MCP server for SimpleLogin alias, mailbox, domain, settings, and account workflows.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Run the container as an MCP stdio server.

environmentVariables.name: SL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SimpleLogin API key created from Settings -> API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: SL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: SimpleLogin web app origin for app.simplelogin.io or a self-hosted instance.

environmentVariables.name: SL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout to the SimpleLogin API, in milliseconds.
